item.title: IDF destroys Iranian internal security headquarters
item.description: A short while ago, the Israel Air Force, guided by IDF intelligence, completed an additional wave of strikes targeting dozens of command centers and headquarters belonging to the Iranian terror regime.

item.title: Operation Roaring Lion: Live updates
item.description: Israel and US launch strikes against the Iranian regime. The regime responds by attacking nations in the region, including Israel. Live Updates.

item.title: Diaspora Minister: 'It won't be simple, but we will reach our ultimate goal'
item.description: Diaspora Minister Amichai Chikli visited the scene of the deadly Iranian missile strike in Beit Shemesh and vowed that Israel would carry on despite the losses.

item.title: IDF: Elimination of top Iranian terror axis officials complete
item.description: Elimination of  Ali Khamenei in Tehran constitutes the culmination of a sustained effort to eliminate the senior leadership of the Iranian terror axis over the past two and a half years.

item.title: Trump: Iran operation to take 'four weeks or less'
item.description: Trump tells Daily Mail Iran operation is a 'four-week process,' confirms three US casualties, says strikes are going as planned.

item.title: Netanyahu pledges on the roof of the Kirya: Intensity of strikes will only grow
item.description: Standing on the roof of the military headquarters in the heart of Tel Aviv, the Prime Minister says that the combined US-Israeli forces 'enables us to strike the terrorist regime decisively.'

item.title: Squadron Commander: 'Every strike reduces the threat to Israel'
item.description: The commander of Squadron 107, who led strikes in Iran, describes the feelings during the mission assigned to him.

item.title: Purim, 2026; War with Amalek
item.description: Amalek, the evil force that Haman represented then, and now, is recognizable in the Iranian regime controlled by Shiite clerics, and Muslim terrorists, such as ISIS, and Islamic Jihadists throughout the world. Opinion.

item.title: Arab affairs correspondent: After two days of strikes, Iran is stuttering
item.description: Channel 12 analyst believes Iran is looking to end the war by surrendering to the US demands.

item.title: IDF destroys IRGC Intelligence, Air Force HQ in Tehran
item.description: After achieving air superiority over Tehran, the IDF struck dozens of IRGC and intelligence headquarters, degrading Iran’s command-and-control.
